name: Aedar
source:
Aedar is a shy, soft spoken Arulian farmer who works on the station's agricultural deck.

He loves his work nurturing the the plants that will go on to nurture and feed his community, and feels most at home when he's gardening.

He has a big heart and an even bigger appetite.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/330388878/love-at-the-milky-way-diner/description]Kickstarter[/url]]
